title: Burn marks on the northeast side of the Colossi of Memnon

tellings.quote: stone statues in the world called the colassi of mnon and they have burn marks only on the northeast side

plain: The Colossi of Memnon, a pair of huge ancient stone statues in Egypt, have burn marks only on their northeast side. The researcher Matt LaCroix says this without naming a source. He tells it as a clue to some great event in the distant past, since the marks face just one direction.
